visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoor street scene in a busy Japanese shopping district during the day. A large '0101' Marui building stands in the background. Dozens of pedestrians are walking across a crosswalk. Lighting is bright, natural daylight. (2) Close-up shot inside a retail store. A hand holds a product package for 'Home Socks' that are toeless and fuzzy white. The background shows other colorful socks on display racks under bright indoor lighting. (3) Close-up of arm knit covers in grey and blue packaging hanging on a store rack. The hand adjusts the position of the products. (4) Close-up of 'Yubi Danro' five-toe half-socks in a black box. The packaging features an illustration of a foot. (5) Close-up of a pink package for 'Toe Inner Socks' designed to keep toes warm. (6) A mannequin head is shown wearing a grey knitted fake turtleneck collar. The camera moves slightly to show more collars on a 'Wing the Bargain' rack. (7) A hand flips through several 'shirt fake collars' on hangers, showing white, blue, and textured beige options. The setting is a brightly lit clothing store aisle. (8) Close-up of pantyhose packaging with a detailed female character illustration. The packaging changes to show different skin tone options (yellowish vs. purple undertones). (9) Wide outdoor shot of the iconic red brick Tokyo Station building under a clear evening sky. A few people are seen walking in the large plaza in front. (10) A pink and white graphic outro screen appears with social media icons and text links.
